items.title: Restriction of scalars is left adjoint to Hom from S
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For a ring map from R to S the lemma states that restriction of scalars from S-modules to R-modules is left adjoint to the functor taking M to Hom_R(S, M) (statement lines 2708-2717). The proof writes both directions of the claimed bijection on elements: an R-module map alpha gives alpha'(n)(s) = alpha(s n), and an S-module map beta gives beta'(n) = beta(n)(1) (proof lines 2719-2724). The only step not written out is the mutual-inverse verification, which the author explicitly marks as omitted and which is a routine computation with the two displayed formulas; the count therefore rests on the two constructions, which are fully given. H2.
